title: fix(example-showcase): label the project and invoice owner text field "Owner Email"

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:showcase 的项目(`showcase_project`)和发票(`showcase_invoice`)上自带的文本字段 `owner` 改名显示为 "Owner Email"(中文 负责人邮箱),API 名仍是 `owner`。
- 为什么改:平台给这两个对象注入的 `owner_id`(用户查找字段)也叫 "Owner",管理员在字段列表、选择器、筛选里看到两个 "Owner",只能靠 API 名分辨;该字段在种子数据里存的就是负责人的邮箱。
- 风险与回滚:只改示例应用的两个显示标签和中英文翻译,不改字段名、数据、流程或权限规则;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/project.object.ts`、`examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts`、`examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm dev` 打开 showcase 的项目或发票列表,点列设置或筛选,预期只看到一个 "Owner"(用户)和一个 "Owner Email"(文本)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`showcase_project` and `showcase_invoice` each declare a text field `owner` labelled "Owner". The registry also injects `owner_id`, a `sys_user` lookup labelled "Owner", so each object listed two "Owner" fields in the field grid, pickers and filters.

The authored field is now labelled **"Owner Email"** on both objects, with the zh-CN translation **负责人邮箱**. The label comes from what the field holds in the seed rows:

- `showcase_project.owner` holds the provisioned persona emails (`ADMIN_EMAIL`, `PHONE_DEMO_USER.email`, `AUDITOR_DEMO_USER.email`). The notify flows read it as an email-shaped recipient, as the seed's header comment explains.
- `showcase_invoice.owner` holds `ada@example.com`-style addresses. The `showcase_contributor` row-level-security rule compares it to `current_user.email`, and the source comment above the field already called it "Owner email".

The API name stays `owner`, so seeded rows, flows (`record.owner`), the RLS rule and every test that names the field are unchanged. The translation bundle follows in both locales it carries (`en` and `zh-CN`). The platform's zh-CN label for `owner_id` is 所有者 (`i18n-resolver` in `@objectstack/spec`), so the zh-CN labels stay distinct too.

Files: the two object files, `src/system/translations/index.ts` (four `owner` entries) and a patch changeset for `@objectstack/example-showcase`. The root `.changeset/config.json` ignores only `@object-ui/example-*`, not this package, and an earlier showcase changeset set the precedent.

## Tests

<details><summary>Registry reading, fix and control (in-process ObjectQL registry, the two objects registered as the app registers them)</summary>

A throwaway vitest file, deleted after the run (`git status` clean), registered `Project` and `Invoice` in a real `ObjectQLPlugin` registry and printed the stored field labels.

On this branch (head 832181e1):

```
READING showcase_project: owner.label="Owner Email" owner_id.label="Owner" owner_id.reference=sys_user fields-labelled-Owner=["owner_id"]
READING showcase_invoice: owner.label="Owner Email" owner_id.label="Owner" owner_id.reference=sys_user fields-labelled-Owner=["owner_id"]
```

Control: the two object files restored to the base commit 5e1342a6 (tree only), with the same run:

```
READING showcase_project: owner.label="Owner" owner_id.label="Owner" owner_id.reference=sys_user fields-labelled-Owner=["owner_id","owner"]
READING showcase_invoice: owner.label="Owner" owner_id.label="Owner" owner_id.reference=sys_user fields-labelled-Owner=["owner_id","owner"]
```

The files were restored from `HEAD` afterwards. `git diff HEAD` on them was 0 bytes and the blob hash matched `HEAD`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No test pinned the label "Owner" on either object's `owner` field. I searched `examples/app-showcase/**`, `ui/**` (fixtures, e2e specs), `packages/qa/dogfood`, `packages/lint` and the root folders for "Owner" next to `showcase_project` or `showcase_invoice`. The `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` "Owner" assertions read `showcase_account.owner_id`, not these fields. So no test reads the new label, and no ablation applies.
- `ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageSummaryAmount-12534.test.tsx` keeps an inline copy of `showcase_invoice` (its header dates the copy to objectstack `9e0945cf4`) with `owner` labelled "Owner". It asserts nothing about that label, and it describes a dated snapshot, so I left it alone.
- No new test pins the label. A label is display copy, and the card's ruling puts a platform-side guard against an authored label that matches an injected one out of scope, as a separate triage question.
- The live `GET /api/v1/meta/object` reading was not taken. `pnpm dev -- --fresh` stopped at its prereq check because the Console's `ui/` packages had no build output in this worktree. The in-process registry reading above stands in for it.
